limitations: Treasury curve history is current-vintage and is not a revision-vintage archive.
The 5Y5Y inflation feature is a transparent approximation derived from Treasury 5Y/10Y nominal and real par yields, not FRED T5YIFR.
Daily Treasury and derived inflation-expectation observations are delayed one trading day before model use.
The broad-dollar series is delayed two trading days before model use.
State provenance columns expose source observations, carried values, staleness, and publication lag.

dfii10.description: U.S. Treasury daily real par yield at 10 years; proxy for the DFII10 concept

dgs10.description: U.S. Treasury daily nominal par yield at 10 years; proxy for the DGS10 concept

dgs2.description: U.S. Treasury daily nominal par yield at 2 years; proxy for the DGS2 concept

t5y5y_inflation_proxy.description: Approximate 5Y5Y inflation expectation from Treasury nominal and real par curves
